verdict.rationale: NVIDIA documents official SDKs for building GPU-accelerated applications. The CUDA Toolkit is described as a development environment with C++ and Python tile-kernel programming and Nsight profiling tools. The HPC SDK supplies C, C++ and Fortran compilers, and the CUDA-X libraries (cuML, cuDF) offer drop-in Python APIs. Missing for 10: SDK documentation that explicitly confirms H200/Hopper support, and independent or hands-on corroboration of developers building against these SDKs on H200.
